name: Hattush
title: Scribe and family leader during the return from exile
summary: Hattush was a descendant of David through Shekaniah, and one of the leaders who returned to Jerusalem from Babylon. He is mentioned in several contexts in the books of Ezra and Nehemiah, both as a participant in the rebuilding of Jerusalem's wall and as one who sealed the covenant with God. He was also a scribe who traveled from Babylon to Jerusalem with Ezra.

keyEvents.title: Genealogy of David's descendants
keyEvents.description: Hattush is mentioned as a descendant of King David through the line of Shekaniah, showing his royal lineage.

keyEvents.title: The journey from Babylon with Ezra
keyEvents.description: Hattush, one of the sons of Shekaniah, was among those who went up from Babylon to Jerusalem with Ezra during the reign of King Artaxerxes.

keyEvents.title: Rebuilding of Jerusalem's wall
keyEvents.description: Hattush, son of Hashabneiah, was one of those who participated in rebuilding Jerusalem's wall under Nehemiah's leadership.

keyEvents.title: Sealing of the covenant
keyEvents.description: Hattush was among the leaders who sealed the covenant to follow God's law, as Nehemiah organized it after the completion of the wall.
